expected.no reveal at the end of the head: the watch catches the snippet during parsing, so this second pass is reachable only when new MutationObserver threw - it is the belt under that, and nothing in a test can make it throw
expected.no watch while the head arrives: the watch reveals on the microtask after the snippet script, and the DOMContentLoaded pass reveals a tick later, so the two differ only in timing. jsdom does not drain microtasks between inline scripts while parsing, so the suite cannot see the difference - in a browser it is a blank page for a microtask rather than until the head is finished
